summary: Adds the stat-eyebrow rule to any prompt that asks for design work, before a layout is chosen.
doc: This UserPromptSubmit hook adds the stat-eyebrow rule to the model's context when the prompt mentions design work, such as a layout, cover, card, slide, deck, thumbnail, dashboard or chart. The rule says never to generate, propose or list a card where a giant number is the dominant type and a small all-caps tracked label sits beside it, and to lead with a sentence instead. It pairs with no-stat-eyebrow, which blocks the card when it is written. It never blocks anything, and it stays silent on prompts with no design words.
